review.summary: Exterior cabinet, door frame/handle and vents are coherent. Read-only cutaways of both standard export and cached inner-preserving postprocess show no spanning horizontal shelves; interior horizontal-area probes are zero. The recovered version adds shallow inner-wall detail but not the five shelf plates required by the reference. Preserve this one shape and its recovery evidence for a local cavity/glazing/shelf correction; do not approve an opaque empty box as the finished fridge.

issues.problem: Five real shelf plates are absent in both inspected postprocess variants; glazing must reveal a real interior.
